title: Personalized Baseball Bedding Full Size Flag Custom Name D - Design 03
description:
Elevate your bedroom decor with this personalized Baseball Comforter Set from Jeminise, perfect for any baseball player or fan. This set combines comfort with a passion for the game, making it an ideal gift.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your name for a unique touch.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in US Twin, Full, Queen, and King to fit various beds.
  • Superior Manufacturing: Features environmental protection techniques for fade-resistant colors and smooth, compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Premium Material: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with microfiber filling, ensuring a soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight feel.
  • Thoughtful Gift: An excellent present for men, women, moms, dads, and perfect for Valentine's, Mother's Day, Father's Day, and Christmas.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water and can be air-dried for quick, fluffy results.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover for your convenience.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester, Cotton
Pattern Baseball
Selected Design Baseball Thunder
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Included Components Duvet Cover
Customization 2 text inputs
Special Feature Breathable
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Thread Count 400
